in_hebrew.name: Shannen
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Graceful, God's gift
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Shannen הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Shannen is believed to have Irish origins, derived from the word 'sean', meaning 'old' or 'wise', and 'eann' which means 'grace'. This name evokes the idea of a wise and graceful being. In Christianity, it can be seen as a reminder of God's gift of wisdom and grace to each of us.
